Level 17 Initial Numbers Diagnostics
====================================

Interpretation
--------------
Equilibrium initial numbers are the numbers-at-age implied by R0 and fixed M
before estimating the age-specific initial-number deviations. Fitted initial
numbers multiply that equilibrium vector by exp(init_log_number_dev_age_a).
Large reductions in old ages or the plus group indicate that recruitment
deviations were likely compensating for an incorrect initial age structure.
